name: Victory for the Horde
label: Quest
description: Victory for the Horde: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have accomplished the impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Take her head and present it to your Warchief.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Thrall's stoic demeanor changes for a split second when he sees the enormous head of Onyxia. The mighty Doomhammer was nearly unsheathed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is a great victory for the Horde, friend. So many times you have honored your Warchief. It is time for the Warchief to honor you.
